mr.title: Reject empty import payloads and skip duplicate SKUs

ticket.summary: Imports with an empty rows array return 204 and silently do nothing; duplicate SKUs create duplicate rows.

summary.intent: Make POST /api/imports reject empty or malformed payloads and stop creating duplicate rows for an existing SKU.
summary.approach: Validation moves into ImportRequest, ImportService returns an ImportResult with imported/skipped counts, and the row cap comes from a new config key. The route gets a throttle.
risk_reasons: The endpoint now answers 201 with a JSON body instead of 204, which existing clients may not expect.
Duplicate detection is a per-row query (N+1) and is not atomic under concurrent imports.

chapters.title: Validate the import payload
chapters.order_reason: Contract first: what the endpoint accepts and returns, before the logic behind it.
chapters.intent: The request class starts rejecting empty and malformed payloads, and the controller reports what happened.

blocks.what: ImportRequest now requires a non-empty rows array, and each row needs a string sku and an integer qty of at least 1.
blocks.why: SHOP-1370: an empty rows array was accepted and silently did nothing.

impact.note: Payloads that passed before (empty rows, missing qty) now return 422.

watch: Check that no client sends qty as a numeric string; 'integer' rejects "3" only in strict mode.

blocks.what: The controller passes validated rows to the service and answers 201 with the imported/skipped counts instead of 204.
blocks.why: The MR description says callers need to know how many rows were skipped.

impact.note: Response status and body change; any client checking for 204 breaks.

watch: Response contract change is not mentioned in the ticket.

rules_flags.rule: API changes need a changelog entry
rules_flags.note: No CHANGELOG.md change in this MR.

probes.question: What happens if a row has a valid sku but qty is 0?

chapters.title: Import logic: cap and duplicate skipping
chapters.order_reason: Domain next: the behaviour the contract promised.
chapters.intent: The service enforces a row cap and skips SKUs that already exist, returning counts.

blocks.what: run() now returns an ImportResult and throws TooManyRowsException above import.max_rows.
blocks.why: Unclear: neither the ticket nor the MR explains why a cap was added.

impact.note: Return type changed from void to ImportResult.

watch: ReimportCommand also calls run() and is not in this diff; check it still works with the new exception.

blocks.what: Each row is checked against existing SKUs; existing ones are counted as skipped, new ones are created.
blocks.why: SHOP-1370 asks to stop creating duplicate rows.

impact.note: One query per row; 5000 rows means 5000 extra queries.

watch: Two concurrent imports can both pass the exists() check and create a duplicate. No unique index is added.

probes.question: What if the same sku appears twice inside one payload?
What if the payload has exactly max_rows rows?

chapters.title: Wiring: route, config, dependency
chapters.order_reason: Wiring after the logic it connects.
chapters.intent: The route is throttled, the cap becomes configurable and a math library is added.

blocks.what: POST /imports gets the throttle:imports middleware, and config/import.php defines max_rows (default 5000, env IMPORT_MAX_ROWS).
blocks.why: The row cap needs a config home; the throttle limiter 'imports' is not defined in this diff.

impact.note: Limiter must exist, otherwise the route throws at runtime.

blocks.why: Unclear: no code in this MR uses brick/math.
watch: An unused dependency; ask the author.

chapters.title: Tests
chapters.order_reason: Tests last: they confirm the behaviour described above.
chapters.intent: Two feature tests pin the 422 on empty payloads and the skip-duplicate counts.

blocks.what: Adds a test for the empty-rows 422 and one for skipping an existing SKU.
blocks.why: Covers the two behaviours from SHOP-1370.
watch: No test for the row cap or the in-payload duplicate.
